_comment: Every file is served from public/assets/docs/ on our own domain.
Forms go stale. When the carrier or FINRA revises one, add the new file
under a new dated name and repoint 'file' — do not overwrite in place,
because netlify.toml caches that folder for a week.
The mutual fund forms came off on 2026-09-25 with the scope restriction
and went back on 2026-10-01 when mutual funds returned to the business.

groups.title: Opening an account
groups.intro: Every new relationship starts with the account form. Your representative will tell you which of the others apply.

forms.title: New Account Form
forms.note: Required for every new account, whatever you are placing.

groups.title: Mutual funds
groups.intro: Ask your representative which share class applies and whether you qualify for a breakpoint discount before either of these is filled in.

forms.title: Mutual Fund Investment Form
forms.note: Accompanies the new account form when you are investing in a fund.

forms.title: Change of Dealer Authorization
forms.note: Moves an existing fund position held elsewhere to your First Asset representative.

groups.title: Annuities and variable life
groups.intro: A variable annuity, a registered index-linked annuity and a variable universal life policy are all long-term contracts with surrender charges and ongoing fees. Read the prospectus before you sign anything.

forms.title: Annuity Forms (VA-1 and VA-3)
forms.note: Used both for a new purchase and for a 1035 exchange of one contract for another.
